items.title: Palmas (TO) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 27 #003
items.en_title: Palmas (TO) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 27 #003
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Palmas (TO) is procuring healthcare goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 6,473,768.15; proposals close Nov 27 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
